question: On the committed delivered predictions, does the |z| >= 3 retention screen fire on wrong candidates without ever firing on correct ones?
cohort: Truth-verified controls in data/integrated_best (rank-1 candidate and best-in-top-10 candidate per control), observed retention indices joined from data/feature_rows feature keys.

preliminary_reading.reasoning: Scoring only two candidates per control the screen already touches 7.8% of scoreable controls on its best library, every flagged candidate is wrong against the known structure, and no correct candidate is flagged. The full top-10 audit can only raise the fire rate; the false-kill bar it must still clear is the same.

scope_note: A preliminary lower bound for tools/audit_topk_retention.py: it scores two candidates per control instead of the full reported list, on the cohort whose structures are known. The full-list audit on reranked outputs supersedes it.
